1.consolidated_definition: ‘Fornicar con mujer.’ Maura. “Todavía era una muchachita, cuando surgió el rumor de que se la habían pasado por las armas unos cuantos vagos del pueblo.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To have illicit relations with a woman. Maura. "She was still a young girl when the rumor spread that she had been taken advantage of by several idle men from the town."
